jobs.title: Director, Analytics & Insights
jobs.description:
Department:
Technology

Location:
Waterloo, ON

Compensation:
CA$130,000 - CA$170,000 / year

Description

What we do every day to be our very best

Every day at Securian Canada means a day spent helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. We’re agile and innovative, and we aren't afraid to challenge and create, or bring diverse perspectives to our work.

Who We Need

As our Director, Analytics & Insights
, you'll help shape how data drives decisions across Securian Canada.

We're looking for a leader who sees beyond dashboards and reports. Someone who is energized by complex business challenges, naturally curious about what drives performance, and passionate about transforming data into meaningful business outcomes. You'll play a pivotal role in building and evolving an enterprise analytics capability
that empowers leaders with trusted insights, scalable analytics products, modern business intelligence, and practical AI-enabled solutions
.

Reporting to the AVP, Data Solutions, you'll lead a multidisciplinary team
responsible for Analytics & Insights, Business Intelligence, and Analytics Engineering. Working across business and technology teams, you'll help create a shared understanding of customers, products, markets, financial performance, and organizational priorities, enabling smarter decisions at every level of the organization.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on leadership
. You'll influence enterprise priorities
, guide complex analytical initiatives, challenge assumptions, and help leaders translate insights into action.

The leader we're looking for combines strong business judgment with technical depth
. You start with the decision that needs to be made, not the tool that will be used. You understand that data and analytics are strategic business assets
and know how to balance immediate business needs with scalable enterprise solutions. You're pragmatic, collaborative, governance-minded, and skilled at translating complex analytical concepts into compelling business narratives that drive action.

Most importantly, you're passionate about building high-performing teams
, developing talent
, fostering collaboration, and creating an environment where people can do their best work while making a meaningful impact
.

At Securian Canada, analytics is about more than understanding what happened. It's about helping people make better decisions that support our mission of helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. You'll join a team of talented professionals who are committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and creating solutions that make a real difference across our business.

The base salary range for this position is between $130,000 to $170,000 depending on experience. Details of our additional benefits are outlined below. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Only one position is available. However, it may be based in multiple locations: Toronto (ON), or Waterloo (ON), or Montreal (QC).

What You Will Do

Lead Enterprise Analytics Strategy & Decision Support

Define and execute an analytics and insights roadmap aligned with enterprise, market, customer, and partner priorities.
Transform strategic business questions into actionable analytical opportunities, KPI frameworks, data requirements, and decision-support solutions.
Deliver meaningful insights into business performance, customer behaviour, claims experience, product results, portfolio trends, operational effectiveness, and emerging risks.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready narratives that drive informed decision-making.
Establish scalable practices that improve prioritization, delivery, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement.

Build Modern Analytics Products & Business Intelligence Capabilities

Lead the evolution from fragmented reporting toward trusted, enterprise-scale analytics products.
Oversee the development of curated datasets, semantic models, certified metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and client-facing reporting solutions.
Partner with Data Pipeline Engineering, Technology, Governance, Finance, and business leaders to strengthen analytics foundations and support critical business priorities.
Improve self-service analytics capabilities while reducing manual effort, duplicated logic, and disconnected solutions.
Ensure analytics products are scalable, reliable, understandable, and centered around real business decisions.

Advance AI, Machine Learning & Analytical Innovation

Identify practical opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, and AI can create measurable business value.
Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, data readiness, adoption potential, and long-term sustainability.
Establish governance, controls, explainability, data quality standards, and operating requirements needed to support responsible AI and advanced analytics.
Guide innovative solutions from ideation through implementation, ensuring clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and long-term success.

Develop High-Performing Teams & Analytics Capabilities

Lead, coach, and inspire a team of professionals across analytics, insights, business intelligence, reporting, and analytics engineering.
Foster a culture focused on analytical excellence, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and business partnership.
Provide guidance on analytical problem solving, data-product design, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.
Help team members grow beyond traditional reporting by strengthening skills in problem framing, root-cause analysis, insight generation, and strategic recommendations.
Create an environment where innovation, curiosity, and measurable business outcomes are valued and celebrated.

Build Strong Partnerships Across the Organization

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping connect business priorities to data-driven solutions.
Build strong relationships across Data Solutions, Technology, Finance, Operations, and business teams.
Influence decision-making by bringing clarity, insight, and strategic perspective to complex challenges.
Champion a data-informed culture that increases confidence, consistency, and trust in organizational decision-making.

What You Will Bring

University degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data science, decision support, or related fields, including leadership responsibilities.
Demonstrated success building, transforming, or significantly advancing enterprise analytics capabilities within a complex organization.
Strong experience translating ambiguous business challenges into actionable analytical solutions, meaningful insights, and measurable outcomes.
Deep expertise in SQL, Python, analytical data modeling, business intelligence platforms, and modern cloud data environments.
Experience developing scalable analytical datasets, curated data products, KPI frameworks, semantic models, and enterprise reporting solutions.
Strong understanding of modern data ecosystems, from source systems and data engineering through analytics delivery and business consumption.
Experience applying advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, or AI-enabled solutions to business challenges.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders while effectively leading highly technical teams.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience building, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams.
Experience within insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is considered an asset.
Experience with cloud data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, and modern self-service BI platforms.
Knowledge of responsible AI practices, model governance, data quality, lineage, explainability, and operational controls.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and inspire action through data.
A strategic and product-oriented mindset focused on delivering sustainable, scalable solutions that create long-term business value.

Why join?

When you’re a part of Securian Canada, you’re a member of an agile and innovative, high-performing, bright-thinking, make-things-happen culture – so that together, we can discover the art of possible.

At our company, we see your potential on day one and challenge you to grow your unique strengths as you create a career filled with opportunity, collaboration, and purpose.

You’ll also be part of a team that’s committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and who values diverse perspectives, so that you can be the person you want to be – both in, and outside, work.

Securian Canada offers a competitive total rewards program with a variety of perks and benefits, including:

Flexible work arrangements with monthly financial allocations to support your work-life balance;
Generous starting paid vacation time, plus additional vacation days for every year of service;
Paid volunteer day so you can dedicate time to a cause you are passionate about;
Paid personal and wellness days to support your total wellbeing;
Educational assistance of up to $3,500 a year (with approval from your manager);
Flexible health and wellness account (in addition to comprehensive drug and dental coverage) to help pay for a wide range of wellbeing services that are meaningful to you;
Up to 14% of combined contributions to the RRSP matching program;
Family-friendly maternity/parental leave and,
Many more benefits, perks and programs.

If you have at least 70% of the qualifications we're looking for, want to work in a fast-growing, leading and progressive company, and feel driven to help Canadians and their families build secure futures – we want to hear from you!

Take the first step in building your future with Securian Canada. Apply now.

Securian Canada is committed to providing a barrier-free work environment and equal access to employment for all qualified applicants. As such, upon request, Securian Canada will work with applicants that require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. Please contact careers@securiancanada.ca for accommodation requests. All information shared during any accommodation request process will be stored and used only in a manner that is consistent with applicable laws and Securian Canada/Canadian Premier Life Insurance Company policies.

jobs.title: Enterprise Service Management (ESM) Transformation Director
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Enterprise Service Management (ESM) Transformation Director based in Canada.

This is a senior commercial and transformation leadership role focused on driving enterprise service management growth across strategic and enterprise accounts.

You will combine consulting leadership, enterprise sales, offering development, and client value realization to deliver measurable business outcomes.

The role involves advising senior executives on modernizing service delivery across IT and business functions such as HR, Finance, Legal, Facilities, and Procurement.

You will shape multi-year transformation roadmaps spanning operating models, governance, processes, platforms, automation, employee experience, and AI-enabled service delivery.

You will also help build scalable go-to-market strategies, strengthen strategic partnerships, and turn successful client engagements into repeatable offerings.

Success will depend on your ability to connect commercial growth with high-quality delivery, executive relationships, sustainable adoption, and measurable value.

This is an opportunity to influence enterprise transformation at scale while working across sales, consulting, delivery, technology partners, and client leadership teams.

Accountabilities

Commercial Growth: Own the ESM transformation portfolio across strategic and enterprise accounts, with accountability for qualified pipeline, bookings, revenue, margin, client outcomes, satisfaction, and account growth.
Account Leadership: Partner with Sales Account Executives to identify and qualify new-logo and expansion opportunities, leading transformation consulting activities from opportunity discovery through executive alignment, solution shaping, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Strategic Account Expansion: Develop account strategies that expand adoption across ESM strategy, service-management operating models, Jira Service Management, employee service delivery, workflow automation, governance, and AI-enabled capabilities.
Executive Advisory: Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, COOs, CHROs, CFOs, service-management executives, and business-function leaders, creating pathways from initial service-management needs to broader enterprise transformation.
Offering Development: Identify market needs, emerging technologies, and client challenges that can be converted into repeatable ESM propositions, defining target audiences, value propositions, delivery approaches, qualification criteria, pricing assumptions, and supporting proof points.
Transformation Solutioning: Design and lead end-to-end ESM transformation frameworks connecting strategy, operating models, governance, processes, technology, organizational change, adoption, and value realization.
Service Management Transformation: Lead solutioning across service catalogs, request fulfillment, incident, problem and change management, knowledge management, asset and configuration management, service-level management, reporting, workflow automation, and continual improvement.
Technology Enablement: Shape solutions involving Jira Service Management, Assets, Confluence, Atlassian Cloud, Rovo, AI-enabled service operations, integrations, data, reporting, and enterprise workflow orchestration.
Go-to-Market: Develop and execute ESM transformation go-to-market strategies with Sales, Marketing, Practices, regional leadership, and strategic technology partners, including industry plays, executive briefings, workshops, events, thought leadership, and joint campaigns.
Sales Enablement: Equip Account Executives with discovery frameworks, qualification guidance, messaging, case studies, proposal materials, value hypotheses, and commercial plays that strengthen ESM opportunities.
Partner Ecosystem: Develop partner-led opportunities with technology providers and build differentiated, scalable solutions and demand-generation motions.
Client Value & Delivery: Maintain executive alignment through steering committees, QBRs, outcome reviews, and transformation governance while partnering with engagement and delivery leaders to manage execution, risks, escalations, quality, and account expansion.
Value Realization: Connect transformation initiatives to measurable outcomes such as improved employee and customer experience, faster request resolution, greater self-service adoption, reduced manual effort, stronger controls, improved SLA performance, and lower operating costs.
Practice Development: Convert successful engagements into reusable methods, accelerators, case studies, benchmarks, and expansion plays while mentoring consultants and supporting the continued development of the ESM practice.

Requirements

Experience: 10+ years in consulting, professional services, enterprise technology, or service-management roles, including at least 5 years in client-facing leadership positions such as Client Partner, Engagement Director, Transformation Director, or equivalent.
Commercial Leadership: Proven experience scaling consulting offerings and go-to-market programs, leading multi-million-dollar portfolios, and managing complex enterprise pursuits alongside sales and delivery leadership.
ESM Expertise: Demonstrated experience designing or leading Enterprise Service Management transformations across IT and at least one business function, covering operating models, governance, processes, service catalogs, workflow, experience, and value measurement.
ITSM Foundation: Strong knowledge of incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management, service-level management, reporting, continual improvement, and service governance.
Technology Platforms: Practical experience with enterprise workflow and service-management platforms, preferably Jira Service Management, Assets, Confluence, Atlassian Cloud, integrations, automation, and reporting capabilities.
AI-Enabled Service Management: Experience applying AI, automation, virtual agents, knowledge intelligence, or agentic workflows to service operations and employee service delivery in a responsible and measurable way.
Leadership & Influence: Proven ability to develop high-performing teams, influence cross-functional stakeholders, communicate effectively with executives, and lead consultative sales conversations.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
Preferred Certifications: ITIL 4, ITSM, COBIT, VeriSM, or equivalent service-management certification is valued.
Business Transformation: Experience leading enterprise-wide shared-services, employee-service, or business-function workflow transformations across areas such as HR, Finance, Legal, Facilities, or Procurement.
Service Governance: Experience developing service catalogs, operating-level agreements, service-level objectives, experience measures, governance frameworks, and service-performance dashboards.
AI & Governance: Experience scaling AI and automation in regulated or complex enterprise environments, including responsible AI governance, knowledge management, and integration architecture.
Partner Ecosystem: Established relationships within technology partner ecosystems such as Atlassian, AWS, or Azure, with experience creating joint go-to-market initiatives.
P&L Experience: Previous P&L ownership within consulting or systems integration is a plus.
Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in Canada or the United States without requiring current or future employment visa sponsorship.

Benefits

Compensation: Competitive compensation package with an annual performance-based bonus.
Healthcare: Comprehensive health insurance.
Retirement: 401(k) plan with company matching.
Paid Time Off: Four weeks of PTO per year, plus public holidays.
Remote Work: Flexible remote working policy.
Professional Development: Dedicated time and budget to develop skills and support long-term career growth.
Work-Life Balance: Flexibility and support designed to help employees balance professional and personal priorities.
International Environment: Opportunity to work within a multicultural, international team.
Strategic Impact: Senior-level opportunity to shape enterprise transformation strategies, commercial growth, and measurable client outcomes.
Technology Exposure: Work across modern service-management platforms, workflow automation, AI-enabled service delivery, and enterprise transformation initiatives.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
